implementation.migration: 077_log_archive_s3.sql: per-log object catalog with immutable key and receipt time
implementation.archive: ArchiveLogsS3 uploads immutable JSON objects first, then materializes log_archive and catalog rows in one transaction
implementation.restore: RestoreLogArchiveS3 downloads catalogued objects into the local read cache after restart; missing/corrupt objects fail closed
implementation.cleanup: CleanupLogArchiveS3 deletes object, catalog and local cache; a failed object delete leaves the catalog for retry
implementation.worker: StartLogRetentionWithS3Archive archives, expires objects/catalog/cache and then runs ordinary log expiry; startup restores before serving

covered.077: S3-compatible log objects are readable through native/scoped/compatible readers after materialization, preserving filters, permissions and pagination
covered.078: catalog + objects restore the local read cache after hot/local rows are removed
covered.079: expiry deletes object+catalog+local cache at the log receipt cutoff; failed delete is retryable

limits: log_archive is a materialized read cache; S3 and the catalog are the durable source.
The test uses an in-memory object implementation for archive semantics; path-style S3 PUT/GET/DELETE is covered by the passing spanarchive S3 client owner.
The product is not declared complete.
